notes: Adds missing API exposure and core logic orchestration coverage for Consent Workflow.

FEAT-6-S162.title: Consent Service Core Logic Enforcement
FEAT-6-S162.description: Implement and harden core ConsentService logic enforcing two-tier consent rules including Tier 1 de-identification, Tier 2 identifiable storage authorization, and transition handling between tiers. Ensure Safe Harbor compliance is consistently applied before persistence.

FEAT-6-S163.title: Consent API Endpoints & Tool Router Integration
FEAT-6-S163.description: Expose consent workflow via backend API endpoints and integrate with tool_router to allow agent-triggered consent capture, validation, and tier progression during conversations. Ensure input validation aligns with Pydantic consent models.

FEAT-6-S164.title: Consent Workflow Integration with Unknown Question Handling
FEAT-6-S164.description: Integrate consent workflow into UnknownQuestionService to ensure consent prompts are triggered before storing or processing ambiguous or sensitive user inputs, with enforced de-identification when Tier 2 consent is absent.

FEAT-6-S165.title: Consent Audit Logging and Debug Tracking
FEAT-6-S165.description: Extend debug_logger to capture consent decisions, tier levels, and de-identification actions for auditability. Ensure logs exclude PHI unless Tier 2 consent is explicitly granted and align with existing metadata persistence patterns.

FEAT-6.mitigation: Enforce de-identification at service layer before any persistence and validate via tests.
